verdict.rationale: Community Phone's business page says incoming calls can ring multiple numbers at once or roll to other numbers when the first isn't answered. That covers simultaneous ringing, sequential ringing and overflow to another number. The business plans list advanced call routing, call forwarding, and voicemail with transcription and custom greetings. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that unanswered calls fall through to voicemail, detail on configuring ring groups (members, order, timeouts), and any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing claims.
